|value = 100 |gprice = 1000 }} The '''Amethyst Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|1000}} after completing the [[Quests#Initiation|"Initiation"]] quest. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]]. It can also be found in [[Mystery Box]]es. The Amethyst Ring increases [[Weight|knockback]] by 10% while equipped. Equipping a second Amethyst Ring adds a further 10% knockback, for a total 20% increase. ==Dyeing== Amethyst Ring can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a purple dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==References== Ring::AddEquipmentEffects is called once for each equipped ring by BuffManager::GetValues. {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Rings]] [[de:Amethyst-Ring]] [[es:Anillo de amatista]] [[fr:Bague en améthyste]] [[it:Anello d'ametista]] [[ja:アメシストの指輪]] [[ko:자수정 반지]] [[hu:Ametiszt gyűrű]] [[pt:Anel de ametista]] [[ru:Кольцо с аметистом]] [[tr:Ametist Yüzük]] [[zh:紫水晶戒指]]
